tasks.title: ngv2/contracts.py — Finding/PoC/LiveTestReport dataclasses + ser/de + validate
acceptance_criteria: NEW file ngv2/contracts.py defines module constants SEVERITIES == ('low','medium','high','critical') and VERDICTS == ('confirmed','refuted','error','inconclusive').

Dataclass Finding(id, target, category, severity, title, description, evidence) with evidence defaulting to an empty list; PoC(finding_id, language, code, entrypoint); LiveTestReport(poc_finding_id, verdict, exit_code, stdout, stderr, duration_ms).

Each class has to_dict() -> dict keyed exactly by its field names, a classmethod from_dict(d) that reconstructs an equal instance (evidence defaults to [] when absent), and validate() -> None raising ValueError on contract violations.

Finding.validate raises on severity not in SEVERITIES or any empty/non-str id/target/category/title; PoC.validate raises on any empty/non-str field; LiveTestReport.validate raises on verdict not in VERDICTS or duration_ms < 0 or empty poc_finding_id.

spec.objective: Define the deterministic, pure artifact contracts NobleGreedv2's runtime produces (a Finding, a PoC, and a LiveTestReport) with JSON-dict (de)serialization and validation. Pure data + logic, no I/O.
functional_requirements: @dataclass Finding with fields in order: id:str, target:str, category:str, severity:str, title:str, description:str, evidence:list (default empty list via field(default_factory=list)).
@dataclass PoC with fields: finding_id:str, language:str, code:str, entrypoint:str.
@dataclass LiveTestReport with fields: poc_finding_id:str, verdict:str, exit_code (int or None), stdout:str, stderr:str, duration_ms:int.

Each class: to_dict() returns a plain dict whose keys are exactly the field names (evidence serialized as a list); from_dict(d) is a classmethod returning an instance, defaulting evidence to [] when the key is absent; validate() returns None or raises ValueError.

Finding.validate: ValueError if severity not in SEVERITIES, or if any of id/target/category/title is not a non-empty str. PoC.validate: ValueError if any of the four fields is not a non-empty str. LiveTestReport.validate: ValueError if verdict not in VERDICTS, or duration_ms < 0, or poc_finding_id is not a non-empty str (exit_code may be int or None).
spec.interfaces: ngv2/contracts.py module-level: SEVERITIES, VERDICTS, Finding, PoC, LiveTestReport. Methods to_dict()/from_dict(d)/validate() on each dataclass. Dataclasses use default __eq__ (so from_dict(to_dict(x)) == x).
edge_cases: Finding.from_dict on a dict without 'evidence' -> evidence == [].
from_dict(to_dict(x)) == x for each class (round-trip), including LiveTestReport with exit_code None.
Finding(severity='spicy').validate() raises ValueError; Finding(id='').validate() raises ValueError.
PoC(code='').validate() raises ValueError; LiveTestReport(verdict='maybe') and duration_ms=-1 each raise ValueError.
non_goals: No integration with any other ngv2 module; this is the standalone L0 contract pinned solely by the committed oracle, no broader wiring added.
No I/O, file access, network, globals, or randomness; only dataclasses/typing from the stdlib.
Do not add fields beyond those specified or change field names/order.
Do not use eval, exec, or __import__.

Keep it pure and deterministic.

tasks.title: ngv2/state_machine.py — hunt->...->report phase model + serializable state
acceptance_criteria: NEW file ngv2/state_machine.py defines PHASES == ('hunt','triage','poc','detonate','report','done') and ALLOWED_TRANSITIONS mapping each phase to the tuple of legal next phases (linear hunt->triage->poc->detonate->report->done, with 'done' reachable from every non-terminal phase, and 'done' -> ()).
Dataclass HuntState(phase:str='hunt', findings:list=[]) and class HuntStateMachine wrapping a HuntState.

HuntStateMachine: can_transition(to)->bool; transition(to) raising ValueError on an illegal transition (phase unchanged on raise); add_finding(finding); to_dict()/from_dict(d) round-tripping phase and findings (findings via Finding.to_dict/from_dict imported from ngv2.contracts).

spec.objective: A deterministic hunt->triage->poc->detonate->report->done phase state machine with a serializable state that carries Finding objects. Imports Finding from ngv2.contracts (the L0 dependency).
functional_requirements: class HuntStateMachine: __init__(self, state: HuntState | None = None) sets self.state = state or HuntState(); can_transition(self, to)->bool returns to in ALLOWED_TRANSITIONS.get(self.state.phase, ()); transition(self, to) raises ValueError if not can_transition(to) else sets self.state.phase = to; add_finding(self, finding) appends to self.state.findings.

to_dict(self) -> {'phase': self.state.phase, 'findings': [f.to_dict() for f in self.state.findings]}; classmethod from_dict(cls, d) -> cls(HuntState(phase=d['phase'], findings=[Finding.from_dict(x) for x in d.get('findings', [])])).
spec.interfaces: ngv2/state_machine.py module-level: PHASES, ALLOWED_TRANSITIONS, HuntState, HuntStateMachine. Imports `from ngv2.contracts import Finding`. HuntStateMachine.from_dict is a classmethod.
edge_cases: transition('triage') from 'hunt' succeeds; transition('report') from 'hunt' raises ValueError and leaves phase 'hunt'.
'done' is in ALLOWED_TRANSITIONS[src] for every src in ('hunt','triage','poc','detonate','report').
Round-trip from_dict(to_dict()) preserves phase and the findings list (Finding equality).
non_goals: No integration beyond importing Finding from ngv2.contracts; pinned solely by the committed oracle, no broader wiring.
No I/O, network, globals, or randomness.
Do not redefine Finding here; import it from ngv2.contracts.
Do not use eval, exec, or __import__.

tasks.title: ngv2/detonation.py — deterministic PoC-detonation orchestration over an injected runner
acceptance_criteria: NEW file ngv2/detonation.py defines class DetonationChamber(success_marker:str='VULNERABLE') with detonate(self, poc, target_spec, runner) -> LiveTestReport.

runner is a callable (poc, target_spec) -> (exit_code, stdout, stderr, duration_ms). detonate maps: runner raises -> verdict 'error' with exit_code None, duration_ms 0, stderr carrying the exception repr; exit_code == 0 and success_marker in stdout -> 'confirmed'; exit_code not in (0, None) -> 'refuted'; otherwise -> 'inconclusive'.
The returned LiveTestReport carries poc.finding_id, the verdict, and the runner's exit_code/stdout/stderr/duration_ms (except on the error branch). Deterministic given a deterministic runner.

spec.objective: Deterministic ORCHESTRATION of a PoC detonation. The exploit is DATA (a PoC) and the execution is an INJECTED runner callable, so the chamber is pure and mock-testable (no real subprocess/network here). Produces a LiveTestReport. Imports PoC, LiveTestReport from ngv2.contracts.
functional_requirements: class DetonationChamber with __init__(self, success_marker: str = 'VULNERABLE') storing self.success_marker.
detonate(self, poc, target_spec, runner) -> LiveTestReport. Call runner(poc, target_spec) inside try/except; on ANY exception return LiveTestReport(poc.finding_id, 'error', None, '', repr(exc), 0).

On success unpack (exit_code, stdout, stderr, duration_ms). Verdict: 'confirmed' if exit_code == 0 and self.success_marker in stdout; elif exit_code not in (0, None) -> 'refuted'; else -> 'inconclusive'.
Return LiveTestReport(poc.finding_id, verdict, exit_code, stdout, stderr, duration_ms).
spec.interfaces: ngv2/detonation.py module-level: class DetonationChamber. Imports `from ngv2.contracts import PoC, LiveTestReport`. detonate(self, poc, target_spec, runner) -> LiveTestReport.
edge_cases: runner returns (0, '...VULNERABLE...', '', 12) -> verdict 'confirmed', exit_code 0, duration_ms 12, poc_finding_id == poc.finding_id.
runner raises RuntimeError -> 'error', exit_code None, poc_finding_id preserved.
non_goals: No real subprocess/bwrap/network execution here; the runner is injected. Pinned solely by the committed oracle, no broader wiring.
No I/O, globals, or randomness; the verdict depends only on the runner's return and success_marker.
Do not redefine PoC/LiveTestReport; import them from ngv2.contracts.
Do not use eval, exec, or __import__.
